Enabled.Name: Enable Onsite Play
Enabled.Hint: Replace automatic attack and damage rolls of player characters with a guided flow where the GM types the physical dice results.

RemoveDefeated.Name: Remove defeated from combat
RemoveDefeated.Hint: When enabled, a target that drops to 0 HP is marked defeated and then removed from the turn order. When disabled, it is only marked defeated.

Visibility.Name: Summary visibility
Visibility.Hint: Who can see the summary chat card posted after each action.

ShowAC.Name: Show target AC in dialog
ShowAC.Hint: Show each target's Armor Class in the attack dialog (only the GM sees the dialog).

TrackAmmunition.Name: Track ammunition
TrackAmmunition.Hint: Block attacks with ranged weapons that have no ammunition, and spend one piece of ammunition (or one thrown weapon) per attack. Spell slots and item uses are always checked by dnd5e.

NpcOptIn.Name: Allow opted-in NPCs
NpcOptIn.Hint: Also use the guided flow for non-character actors that were opted in with game.modules.get("onsite-play").api.setOptIn(actor, true).

Targets.Title: Select targets
Targets.Content: No tokens are targeted. Target one or more tokens on the canvas (hover and press T), then press Continue.

Attack.Title: Attack: {item}
Attack.Hint: Type the final attack total (d20 + all modifiers) rolled at the table. Leave blank to skip a target.

Ammo.Label: Ammunition
Ammo.None: {item} has no ammunition. Add ammunition to the character before attacking.
Ammo.NotEnough: Not enough {item}: {needed} needed, {available} available. Nothing was applied.

Damage.Title: Damage: {item}
Damage.Hint: Type the total damage rolled at the table for each target, one number per damage type.

Save.Title: Saving throws: {item}

OnSave.half: On a successful save: half damage
OnSave.none: On a successful save: no damage
OnSave.full: On a successful save: full damage

Save.RollHint: Roll this target's saving throw in Foundry.

Chain.Title: Continue with saving throw?
Chain.Content: {count} target(s) were hit. Also resolve {name} for them?

Undo.Title: Undo this action?
Undo.Content: Restore the HP of every affected target, remove the statuses added, and put removed combatants back into combat.
Undo.Failed: Undo failed. See the console (F12) for details.

Warn.NoGM: Onsite Play: no GM is connected.
Warn.QueryFailed: Onsite Play: could not reach the GM.
Warn.FlowError: Onsite Play: something went wrong. See the console (F12) for details.
Warn.NoActorTargets: None of the targeted tokens has an actor.
Warn.NoDamageParts: This activity has no damage to apply.
Warn.NoHealingParts: This activity has no healing to apply.

Info.SentToGM: Sent to the GM to resolve.

Heal.Title: Healing: {item}
Heal.Hint: Type the healing rolled at the table for each target.
